description: verify-live-migration.mjs runs S3.1 (apply, a real write against production) unconditionally, then S3.2-S3.4 as a post-hoc report. There is no pre-apply precondition check and no automated rollback if S3.4 discovers a real back-compat break after the migration already ran; main() only sets the process exit code. For this additive-only migration the residual risk is low, but the apply-then-verify structure has no documented revert step, which will not be safe to reuse unmodified for a less-trivially-additive future migration.
